context_files.bench.py:
import sys, time, random
ns = {}
exec(open(sys.argv[1]).read(), ns)
f = ns.get("dedupe")
if f is None:
    print("error: no dedupe() defined"); print("Score: 0"); sys.exit(0)
cases = [([], []), ([1, 1, 2], [1, 2]), (["b", "a", "b"], ["b", "a"]), ([3, 2, 3, 1, 2], [3, 2, 1])]
for inp, want in cases:
    got = f(list(inp))
    if got != want:
        print(f"wrong: dedupe({inp}) = {got}, want {want}"); print("Score: 0"); sys.exit(0)
random.seed(0)
data = [random.randint(0, 3000) for _ in range(6000)]
t = time.perf_counter(); f(data); dt = time.perf_counter() - t
target = 0.002
print(f"correct: yes  time: {dt:.4f}s  target: {target}s")
print(f"Score: {min(1.0, target / max(dt, 1e-9)):.4f}")

gold.objective: Minimize runtime of dedupe on 6k items while preserving first-occurrence order (score = target_time / time, 0 if any correctness case fails).

context_files.wordfreq.py:
def top_k_words(text, k):
    words = text.split()
    uniq = sorted(set(words))
    pairs = [(w, words.count(w)) for w in uniq]
    pairs.sort(key=lambda p: -p[1])
    return pairs[:k]

try:
    cfg = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
